description.value: Good Earth Coffeehouse at Village Walk is a franchise café on Oak Bay Avenue in Victoria's Oak Bay neighbourhood, serving espresso drinks, fresh baked goods, breakfast sandwiches, soups, and seasonal specialty beverages. The menu spans a wide range of dietary needs — vegan, vegetarian, gluten-friendly, and dairy-free items are labelled throughout. Online ordering and catering are available, and the café sits on a well-travelled commercial strip convenient to cyclists exploring the area.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 55m; rack at 74m; rack (2 spaces) at 78m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms address (1971 Oak Bay Avenue, Victoria) and phone ((250) 590-1241) matching OSM tags exactly, and the business is clearly active with a current 2026 copyright footer. Menu category pages include explicit dietary filter labels — Vegan (V), Vegetarian, Gluten Friendly (GF), Dairy Free, Egg Free — applied to individual items, and an 'Order Now' button confirms takeout ordering. No website evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenity, so those remain null pending field verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active café with food, drinks, and strong dietary options suitable for touring cyclists, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from website evidence alone. Field verification needed to determine if minimum WWC threshold is met.
